questions.cardText:
[Sociology] What is the term for the process by which individuals internalize the values and norms of a culture?
A. Acculturation
B. Socialization
C. Assimilation
Answer: B.
questions.en: What is the sociological term for the process by which individuals internalise the values and norms of their culture?
questions.de: Wie heißt in der Soziologie der Prozess, durch den Menschen die Werte und Normen ihrer Kultur verinnerlichen?

timeline.labelEn: Georg Simmel defines sociology as the study of the forms of socialization
timeline.labelDe: Georg Simmel definiert die Soziologie als Lehre von den Formen der Vergesellschaftung (Sozialisation)

questions.cardText:
[Physiology and Anatomy] Why does color blindness affect males more than females?
A. Because males have one less X chromosome
B. Because of excessive testosterone
C. Due to a lack of estrogen
Answer: A. The genes responsible for the most common forms of color blindness are on the X chromosome. Males have only one X chromosome, so a single defective gene can cause color blindness, whereas females have two, providing a backup if one is defective.
questions.en: On which chromosome lie the genes for the most common forms of colour blindness, which is why it affects far more males than females?
questions.de: Auf welchem Chromosom liegen die Gene der häufigsten Formen der Farbenblindheit, weshalb sie weit mehr Männer als Frauen betrifft?

timeline.labelEn: John Dalton publishes the first scientific account of colour blindness, his own red–green deficiency
timeline.labelDe: John Dalton veröffentlicht die erste wissenschaftliche Beschreibung der Farbenblindheit, seiner eigenen Rot-Grün-Schwäche
